 {"step":2,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":656,"var":"Q->south_square","code":"if (Q->south_square < 0 || Q->south_square > 3) {","note":"The south-square option is also bounded to the 0..3 range before the projection is activated."},

 {"step":4,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"combine_caps","line":457,"var":"capmap = get_cap(x, y, north_square, south_square, inverse)","code":"CapMap capmap = get_cap(x, y, north_square, south_square, inverse);","note":"Image coordinates are mapped to a cap and rotation state using the configured squares."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"combine_caps","line":473,"var":"tmpRot = rot[get_rotate_index(capmap.cn - pole)]","code":"tmpRot = rot[get_rotate_index(capmap.cn - pole)];","note":"The computed cap number feeds an index lookup into the rotation table, which is the memory access of interest."}

python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
env=os.environ.copy(); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs')
p=subprocess.run([os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs','proj'), '+proj=rhealpix', '+ellps=WGS84', '+north_square=0', '+south_square=0', '-inv'], input=b'0 0\n', env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('rc', p.returncode)
print(p.stdout.decode())
PY
